categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in fine chemical products manufacturing, with main segments including leather chemical products (clean tanning materials, leather functional auxiliaries, coating materials, colorants) and synthetic leather chemical products (water-based polyurethane materials). The company has expanded into adjacent areas including intelligent manufacturing equipment and eco-friendly wood-based panels. The company also engages in trading of chemical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes mature application stage technologies for manufacturing leather chemicals, functional auxiliaries, coating materials, and water-based polyurethane materials. Core technologies include enzyme-based tanning pollution control, acrylic/silicone/polyurethane coating material synthesis, and water-based polyurethane material development. The company operates three R&D centers in Chengdu, Shanghai, and Hefei, with 135 R&D personnel and 107 patents (71 invention patents, 36 utility patents). Production employs standard chemical manufacturing processes with automated and intelligent equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are leather tanning enterprises and synthetic leather manufacturers. End markets include leather goods (handbags, clothing, footwear), automotive interiors, furniture upholstery, and other applications. The company serves customers across China with significant presence in East China (41.29% of revenue), Southwest China (21.71%), and North China (14.59%) regions, plus international markets (4.50% of revenue) including Vietnam, Ethiopia, Mongolia, and Thailand.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. Major production facilities are located in Shanghai (Jinshan Industrial Zone), Chengdu, and Hefei. The company has established over 10 subsidiaries and offices across regions including Sichuan, Hunan, Haining, Guangdong, Wuji, Fujian, Henan, Shandong, Guangxi, Wenzhou, and Xinji. International operations include a Hong Kong subsidiary and planned expansion to Cambodia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the chemical supply chain, manufacturing specialty chemical products for downstream leather and synthetic leather manufacturers. The company sources raw materials directly from suppliers and sells finished chemical products to tanning enterprises and synthetic leather producers. The company also engages in downstream activities through technical service teams providing application support to customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing green, low-carbon, and environmentally-friendly materials to support ecological leather production. Key R&D directions include: bio-based leather chemicals, formaldehyde-free alternatives, chromium-free tanning materials, low-VOC products, water-based polyurethane materials, functional leather additives (water-resistant, anti-stain, sound-dampening), lightweight tanning processes, and advanced coloring technologies. The company emphasizes sustainable manufacturing and circular economy principles aligned with China's dual-carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of chemical products to leather and synthetic leather manufacturers (93.06% of 2023 revenue from direct sales). Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods. The company also generates revenue through agency/distribution channels (6.94% of 2023 revenue). The company provides technical support and application services as part of its customer-centric business model. Subsidiary operations contribute revenue from wood-based panel manufacturing and intelligent equipment manufacturing.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading supplier of leather chemicals in China, holding the position of Vice Chairman of the China Leather Association. The company is one of China's most comprehensive leather chemical product suppliers with the broadest product range. The company competes on product quality, technical service, innovation capability, and comprehensive solutions rather than price alone. Key competitive advantages include extensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, established customer relationships, and technical service network.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized chemical manufacturer with 2023 revenue of 724.6 million yuan, representing 41.97% growth from 2022 (510.4 million yuan). Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 28.4 million yuan in 2023 (compared to -1.8 million yuan loss in 2022). Total assets reached 1.42 billion yuan at year-end 2023. The company employs 1,085 people. The company has demonstrated recovery from 2022 losses with positive profitability in 2023, supported by market recovery and revenue growth across all segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolios addressing the full leather manufacturing process, advanced technical service teams providing customized solutions, and innovation in sustainable and functional materials. Key value propositions include: helping customers reduce production time and costs through optimized chemical solutions, providing environmental compliance through low-VOC and eco-friendly products, enabling functional leather production (water-resistant, anti-stain, sound-dampening), and supporting lightweight manufacturing processes. The company emphasizes long-term customer partnerships and collaborative problem-solving rather than transactional relationships.
